description.value: Red Truck Beer Company is a Vancouver craft brewery and taproom known for its 'workshop' approach to slow-brewed lagers, ales, and IPAs, plus a Truck Stop Diner serving Southern-style smoked meats and brewhouse burgers. The growler filling station lets cyclists top up a reusable vessel with fresh draft beer to go. The venue also hosts live music and a summer concert series, and has noted events ranging from beer festivals to bike rides.

bike_parking_detail: 3 racks within 100m: rack at 16m; rack at 17m; wall_loops (5 spaces) at 63m. Total: 5 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms this is Red Truck Beer Company's craft brewery, taproom, and diner at 295 East 1st Avenue, Vancouver, BC — the OSM name 'Red Truck Growler Filling Station' aligns with the brewery's growler fill offering. Takeout is confirmed via explicit online ordering for beer flats, kegs, and food from the Truck Stop Diner. No evidence on the website for bike parking, water refill, washrooms, or most optional amenities; some subpages were blocked by Cloudflare rate limiting, limiting full review.
concerns: OSM record has no address; address 295 East 1st Avenue, Vancouver, BC sourced from website contact page only.
OSM name 'Red Truck Growler Filling Station' is more specific than the broader 'Red Truck Beer Company' brand — the growler fill is one feature of the full brewery/taproom.
Several subpages returned Cloudflare Error 1015 (rate limited), preventing full amenity review of /good-at-beer/ and /vancouver-beer/.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, operating craft brewery and taproom with growler fills, diner, and online ordering — clearly open and publicly accessible.
